name: brand-ai-readiness-audit
description: A marketplace of focused skills that audit any website for AI-discoverability and on-site-engagement problems, then emit a single prioritized report of findings and fixes. Recommend-only; read-only; robots-respecting.

skills.concern: Composition + reporting: plan the crawl within budget, run the other skills over one shared fetch, dedupe to root cause, apply one severity function, emit the report.
L1 Reachability: robots per-agent, UA discrimination, sitemap, noindex, latency, canonicalization, soft-404.
L2 Readability: raw-vs-rendered gap, facts locked in images/PDF/video, interaction-gated content, semantics.
L3 Extractability: JSON-LD validity/completeness, schema-vs-DOM agreement, quotable definitional facts, meta/canonical.
L4 Corroboration & freshness: sameAs anchors, entity disambiguation, NAP/self consistency, staleness, lastmod credibility.
L5 Query-space: answer the site's own question set from machine-visible text only; pricing/comparison/persona/geo coverage; llms.txt.
Engagement: the AI-referred cold arrival — scent match, orientation, next action, dead ends, interstitials, load cost, mobile, anchors.
